title: Zesty Irish Bacon Pasta
description: A nutty and bouncy Irish dish featuring bacon and a pasta water emulsion, perfect for a date night, and high in protein to keep you satisfied.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine pasta according to the package instructions.
While the pasta is cooking, cook the irish bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside, leaving the grease behind.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the shaved grana padano cheese to the skillet and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the chopped parsley to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining the fettuccine.
Add the cooked fettuccine to the skillet and toss with the cheese sauce, adding some reserved pasta water if needed to achieve a creamy emulsion.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the pasta hot, topped with crispy irish bacon and additional parsley if desired.
